In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria.

In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion.
